spec_match.rationale: Brackets genuine WebRTC activity (the exact thing the spec says the log captures) with the real navigator.rtc start/finish calls including the metadata option from RTCStartDiagnosticLoggingOptions.

interactive.rationale: Run button executes a real loopback RTCPeerConnection pair — offer/answer, ICE, data-channel round-trip — with live state stamps, a timestamped timeline, and a working reset.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises a real loopback call bracketed by real logging calls with honest fallback; verified behavior matches exactly.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers API-absent fallback (call still runs, logging honestly skipped), echo timeout guard, failed-finish path, and repeat-run protection while a run is in flight.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5091582546149376; the page links the on-ramp and both v150 concepts.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite exercises the real contract (UUID resolution, metadata rejection, secure-context gate) rather than broad baseline checks; the page renders the shared support panel with honest fails on unflagged browsers.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: clicked Run, observed both peers reach connectionState connected, the data-channel echo 'HELLO FROM THE CAPTURE WINDOW' complete, and the honest 'logging calls skipped' status; zero console errors/exceptions; before/after screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts rtc-livecall-echo on the real round-trip result and rtc-livecall-start-id / start-rejected on the logging branch; no unhandled rejections (ICE addIceCandidate races are caught).

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; timeline rtc-lines use accent-blue on bg-stone (AA); connected stamps flip to text-black bg + ivory text with both properties set.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with disabled-state management; status line is role=status, timeline role=log aria-live=polite; peer stamps are text, not colour-only (the word 'connected' carries the state).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Two-column peer lanes collapse to one column under 700px; 0px horizontal overflow and no clipped controls at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000; only network failure is the sandbox-blocked fonts CDN common to all pages.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the flag-on path where start/finish bracket the loopback call for real
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium 141 (no RTCDiagnosticLogging feature) only the honest-skip branch of the logging calls could run; the loopback call itself is fully real. Re-run on Chrome ≥150 with --enable-blink-features=RTCDiagnosticLogging to verify the session UUID renders and finish resolves after the call.

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout updates aria-live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Expose streaming state changes as text in live regions and avoid colour-only state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Timeline is role=log aria-live=polite, status is role=status, and peer state is conveyed by the literal connectionState word in each stamp.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless finalEval statusTexts include the timeline and status content.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive button row control panel small screens no overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grid/flex with wrap and single-column collapse on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: lane-grid is 1-column below 700px; ctrl rows flex-wrap; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Report outcome assertions rather than raw noise and keep error paths intentional.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: One assert per meaningful outcome (echo result, logging start/reject); ICE candidate races are swallowed deliberately to keep the console clean.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the loopback RTCPeerConnection call genuinely connects in Chromium 141 — both peers reach 'connected', the data channel round-trips and upper-cases the message — while the diagnostic-logging bracket honestly reports the API's absence. Console and exception-free; both device classes clean. Flag-on verification is blocked by the Chromium 141 binary and recorded as an open question.
